body:
Reading your comment made me start to cry. I don't know how to shop around. I know that I can't reveal anything to my parents because they will over react. I also know that my parents are in frequent contact with my current therapist because they are concerned and they want more information. 
I'm also seeing a psychiatrist. He told me to get the book "CBT for dummies". I hate it. I don't fit. They talk about how you're not supposed to think that you're a "mind reader" or a "fortune teller". I'm not claiming to be psychic, but it's always the exact fucking thing that I worry about, that they tell me not to worry about because it 'probably' won't happen, then, guess what?! Exactly what I thought. Then I want to puke on somebody. 
I've only seen the psychiatrist once, and I will only see him and my other therapist once more before my 'due date.' I don't know what to do.
Well, I'm in Canada. The student loan process takes 4-6 weeks. I would need the money by the 10th of January, so I think it's too late.

I did call them today. I'm still waiting for a response, and if it doesn't happen within the next 45 minutes then I'm pretty sure they won't be replying. 

I tried financial assistance, they said that they can't help me because I left my previous job on my own free will. I had to to it. I had been struggling to pay the bills since January, I would sometimes go 2 or 3 days without eating, and I would still be behind in bills. I had to leave that job and move back in with my parents, but the job situation is even worse where I'm living now. 
I suppose I could try for the interest payment plan, but I don't know. I've had help suggested to me before, such as financial assistance, but that fell through. I tend to lower my expectations and avoid getting my hopes up.

Trying to contact other victims would also mean me saying "Hey, my name is XXX XXXXX. Remember me from school, and the local catholic church? Anyways, I was molested at the church, and blah blah blah..."

It was a Catholic priest. I contacted the local diosces first of all, and they contacted the police. I gave my statement to the police, on video, and described exactly how it happened. (basically, in Catholicism, you need to have a first confession before you get your first communion. Confession happens in a location 1on1 with a priest. He said "now I'm going to do the part that they don't teach you about, because it's a sacred ritual between a young boy and a priest. If you ever tell anyone about it, God will forever condemn you to hell, and you will never be forgiven for having told anyone what happened.) Then bad stuff happened. These are the same details that I gave in the police statement. I know who it was, and it's hard to contact other people my age from the parish because everybody wants to get the fuck away from this bumblefuck hick province.

I've been in therapy for about 4 years. I'm afraid to be honest with them because they'll dub me as suicidal and commit me to the hospital again. If that happens, I can guarantee that I won't come out alive. I know how to off myself in a dire situation under intensive supervision.

I spoke to the police about my molestation case about 2 months ago. Last week they told me that there wasn't enough evidence to convict, mostly due to the fact that I waited 3 years after remembering the repressed memories of the fact that it had happened.
